notes.title: Oculus height issues
notes.content:
Hello,

We have discovered that since the latest Oculus software update some players may find that they are too high in the game and cannot reach the floor.  If you find that you are experiencing this issue please switch over to the 'Oculus Height Fix' beta version of Star Phoenix.

We all hope that this issue will be addressed shortly but in the mean time we will do what we can on our end to make sure everyone has the best possible experience.

Many Thanks

Blazar Games

notes.title: Update 11/02/2017 version 0.2.0
notes.content:
Hello everybody,

The huge update for Star Phoenix is now live!

This update brings huge changes and additions and adds a whole new side to Star Phoenix with elemental power to thow at you enemies!

The Screenshots and trailer have all been update to reflect these changes.  Find a full list of changes below.

0.2.0 Updates:
Added: Character leveling with experience.
Added: Item/Weapon statistics.
Added: Weapon overheat and shoot animations.
Added: New learn as you play tutorial system.
Added: Intro screen.
Added: Fire Element.
Added: Ice Element.
Added: Mana.
Added: Health and Mana display on the palms of your hands.
Added: Mana Cells.
Added: Medibay level.
Added: Boss battles.
Added: Story based quests.

We hope you enjoy this new update and we would love to hear any feedback you have!  If you encounter any issues/bugs we would ask that you post them in the community hub and we will get them fixed asap!

notes.title: Beta testing
notes.content:
As this next update for Star Phoenix has so many changes and additions we have opened up a public beta test for the upcoming updates for Star Phoenix - these beta builds are still under very heavy development but if you would like to see whats coming give it a try!

The public beta for Star Phoenix can be activated through the beta properties in Steam.

We hope you enjoy the new content in this beta!

notes.title: Update 11/12/2016 version 0.1.6
notes.content:
We have decided to roll out the large update in 2 parts.  This update is the 1st of the 2 parts.  Please see update notes below for the new additions in this update.

Update Notes:

Rare weapon variants have been added into the game with lower drop chances - these can also be bought from the shop if you are lucky and can afford them.
Weapons and Items shop - Items/Weapons can be bought and sold here.  Better weapons will be needed to progress in the game due to increased difficulty.
Quests - Cash rewards for doing quests to help in getting better weapons to be able to progress through the game.
Health/damage re-balances - headshots will not always kill in one hit with weaker weapons anymore.
Bug fixes.

notes.title: Update: 02/12/2016 version 0.1.3
notes.content:
We have today released the next update for Star Phoenix, please see update notes below.

Update Notes:

Oculus Rift + Touch controller support added.
Traditional movement system added - for touch this is used with the left thumb stick - for the HTC Vive this mode can be toggled on and off with the menu button.  See in game for full controller mapping.
The Chaperone bounds during teleportation has been removed.
Various AI improvements.
Random events added during the proceedurally generated level.
Teleportation navigation issues fixed.

Please check back regularly for more updates as the game is developed further.  

Thank you for everyone's continued support.

notes.title: Update: 26/11/2016 version 0.1.2
notes.content:
We would like to to start by saying a huge thank you to the community for the fantastic responce we have recieved since the release of the Early Access for Star Phoenix.

We have been listening to your feedback and managed to roll out the 1st update already (although only small)!  Please see the notes about the update below.

We look forward to hearing more feedback to help us make Star Phoenix the best game it can be.


Update Notes:

Ragdoll physics added for zombie deaths.
Navigation tightened to avoid getting stuck.
AI Bug fixes
